item.title: Dispatch Center Launches Tool For Community Feedback - SweetwaterNOW
item.description: SWEETWATER COUNTY — Sweetwater Combined Communications has launched new software aimed to better connect residents with dispatchers. The dispatch center’s new software is a satisfaction and feedback measurement tool that uses text messages to keep residents informed and provide feedback after a non-life-threatening call to 911. item.title: The Hill Early Learning Center Expands, Now Serving Families in Green River and Rock Springs - SweetwaterNOW
item.description: Families in Sweetwater County now have even more options for quality childcare as The Hill Early Learning Center continues to grow, with locations in both Green River and Rock Springs. Designed to support children from infancy through early childhood, The Hill provides a safe, clean, and secure environment where kids can learn, grow, and thrive.
